positions.title: System Validation Engineering Intern
positions.description:
I spent 7 months at Intel in the Client System Validation team. Here I had the chance to learn about the logic of the PCH (Peripheral Control Hub) and the sensors controller. I also was part of a team that developed content to generate traffic on all components of the PCH concurrently.
My projects included: 
 - Debugging of the eSPI protocol.
 - Developing protocol analyzers for the eSPI, SPI and I2C protocols, which reduced debug time significantly.
 - Document and present the validation strategy for sensors controller.
 - Develop python scripts to enable power management states in PCIe end point devices.
 - Collaborate with the Concurrency team to develop a data verification tool for the Low Speed IOs.

volunteerExperiences.description: As a volunteer at the PT Department in the University Health Center at Penn State I had the chance to assist the Physical Therapists on some tasks such as set up of equipment, set up of cold and hot packs for patients, housekeeping of the beds, towels and ice/cold packs, and help patients when learning a new exercise. It was a very fun and gratifying experience!

THON is a dance marathon where many students stand for 46 hours in order to raise money to help families whose child has cancer. The money is donated to the Four Diamonds Fund, which supports those families financially. THON also includes a series of events hosted for those children to have the most fun possible! As a Special Events committee member I was involved in arts and crafts for those events and the set up of the events. It was an awesome experience!!
